name: Costco Kirkland Signature $4.99 Whole Seasoned Rotisserie Chicken (Skinless Breast)
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Wholesale (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted until ultra-tender and juicy: removing the outer skin yields 3+ pounds of zero-fiber, gluten-free, dairy-free, citrus-free lean protein for $4.99.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the seasoned skin during a flare, shred the warm breast meat over white rice, mashed potatoes, or sourdough toast, and save the carcass for gut-healing bone broth.
watchOuts: Discard the outer skin if sensitive to carrageenan/seasoning rub or rendered poultry fat
